subject: Julius
text: Julius and the Girl are found by going north at the Tree of Mana.

evidence.quote:
Go north to find Julius and the Girl. Now prepare to fight for the
future of the world!

subject: Julius (1)
text: In the first battle, Julius transforms himself into three duplicates and attacks with Nuke.

evidence.quote:
The first time you have to battle Julius, he transforms himself into
three different Julius.

BOSS Name:          Julius (1)
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 818
EXP gained:         638
Attacks:            Nuke
Best Equipment:     Exacalibur , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

subject: Julius (1)
text: To defeat the three Julius duplicates, attack them and use the Cure spell.

evidence.quote:
Strategy: Just attack them and use the Cure spell until they are
defeated.

subject: Julius (2)
text: In his second form, Julius transforms into a monster that attacks by shooting Thunder Bolts from his hands and swooping down.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Julius (2)
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 161
EXP gained:         0
Attacks:            Thunder Bolts
Best Equipment:     Exacalibur , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None
Strategy: Julius shoots Thunder Bolts from his hands and swoops down.

subject: Julius (2)
text: Against Julius's second form, dodge when he swoops down and hit him with Excalibur.

evidence.quote:
Have the Exaclibur equipped and the Cure Spell. Dodge Julius when he
swoops down and hit him with your sword.

subject: Julius (Final)
text: The final form of Julius attacks with Nuke and transports to different spots on the screen.

evidence.quote:
BOSS Name:          Julius (2)
Recommended Level:  60
GP:                 ---
EXP gained:         ---
Attacks:            Nuke
Best Equipment:     Exacalibur , Cure Spell
Items Gained:       None

Julius can transport himself to different spots on the
screen.

subject: Julius (Final)
text: During the final battle against Julius, the Girl can heal HP if asked, and the player should stay in the screen's center and strike when he appears.

evidence.quote:
Strategy:  Remember, now that the Girl is with you she can heal some HP
if you ASK her.

The best strategy is to stay in the middle of the screen and
attack Julius when he appears.

subject: Elixir

evidence.quote: Don't hesitate to use Elixir's, which
restore all HP and MP. Eventually you will prevail!
